subject: Prod: intermittent 429s + latency spikes — rate policy ambiguity
messages:
From: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-support@acme-retail.com
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Production: increase in 429s and latency (URGENT)

Hi Karthik / Monica —

We're seeing a sharp uptick in 429s and median p95 latency for our live storefront checkout calls since ~15:00 PDT. Errors are concentrated on the LLM reranking endpoint; about 8% of requests return 429 and many of the successful ones have jumped from ~180ms to 1.6s. This is causing checkout timeouts and cart abandonment.

Example request ids: rq_8f31a, rq_8f31b, rq_8f31c (attached subset of logs). Our QA team confirmed this is not on our side — traffic patterns are steady. We need this prioritized; can you confirm whether this is a rate limit issue or a runtime degradation?

We are on the enterprise plan (ACME-ENT-2028-Q2) and cannot afford downtime during the peak window. Ava Reynolds
Head of Platform, Acme Retail
Attachments: acme_request_samples.log (8KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 17:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: increase in 429s and latency (URGENT)

Ava — thanks for the heads up and for the sample logs. I'm escalating this internally and looping in Monica and Jonas to investigate the routing and quota layers. Apologies for the impact — we'll confirm the root cause within the hour and share mitigations.

Immediate asks: Monica/Jonas can you confirm whether any tenant-level rate policy changes were deployed this afternoon, and whether Acme's burst/quota window matches the live routing profile?

Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0193

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: increase in 429s and latency (URGENT)

Quick update from the infra side — I've pulled the tenant config and traffic traces. Preliminary findings:

- At 14:58 PDT we rolled a policy tweak to the shared-rate-policy that changed the burst_window from 30s to 8s for a set of "cost-optimized" routing rules (targeting non-critical classes).
- The effective token bucket for Acme dropped by ~60% during bursts; under their real traffic shape (short user bursts during checkout) this produces a high 429 tail and queuing in the serving pool, which in turn raised downstream p95 latency.
- No hardware regressions detected; model inference times are stable.

Attachments attached: tenant-rate-config-diff.pdf (policy diff) and burst-window-sim.csv (simulated rejection rate vs burst window).

Immediate mitigation options:
1) Rollback the policy change (fast, but requires risk window).
2) Patch tenant selector to exclude Acme and increase their burst window to 60s for the next 24h.
3) Temporarily route Acme traffic to dedicated capacity pool (if available) — this would add cost but eliminates shared policy risk.

I'm preparing an incident runbook and will run a test after we choose an option. Recommend we do option 2 for fastest low-risk remediation.

-Monica
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: increase in 429s and latency (URGENT)

Team —

Thanks for the analysis, Monica. Karthik, please convey our apologies to Acme and commit to a concrete mitigation timeline. Given the enterprise contract and the user-visible impact, I'm opening this as an executive-visibility incident.

Action items for the next 6 hours:
- Monica: implement option 2 (patch selector + bump Acme burst_window to 60s) and validate with simulated checkout traffic. Target: complete by 10:30 PDT.
- Jonas: prepare a short customer-facing writeup explaining root cause and the short-term fix; include expected timeline for a permanent policy guardrail.
- Karthik: schedule a 30-min call with Ava and their engineering leads for 11:00 PDT to walk the mitigation and agree on credits/next steps.

Also propose a one-week post-mortem and a change to rollout checks to prevent tenant-label collisions. Monica, include test coverage in the PR.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: increase in 429s and latency (URGENT)

Ava — following up with what we did and next steps. Short summary:

- Root cause: a recent shared-rate-policy tweak narrowed the burst window for a targeted routing group; an overlapping tenant selector unintentionally included Acme's reranker route. This led to token-bucket exhaustion under natural checkout bursts and elevated 429s + queuing latency.
- Immediate fix (completed 09:02 PDT): patched selector to exclude Acme and increased Acme's burst_window to 60s. We also bumped their local quota by 35% for the next 24 hours while we validate.
- Observed impact: rejection rate dropped from 8% -> 0.6% in the first 20 minutes; p95 latency returned to ~210ms. Monitoring links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/tenant/acme-retail/metrics

Next steps:
- We're scheduling a 30-min post-incident call tomorrow to walk the plan for a permanent guardrail (policy-tag validation in the change pipeline + pre-deploy selector simulation).
- We're prepared to offer a billing credit for the impact window; Marissa will coordinate the commercial remediation.

I'm sorry for the disruption — we know this was visible and impactful. We'll follow up with the post-mortem and the PR for the rollout guardrail.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0193
Attachments referenced: tenant-rate-config-diff.pdf, burst-window-sim.csv
